rationale: The papers 'Low dust emissivities and radial variations in the envelopes of Class 0 protostars' (1910.04652) and 'Revealing dust segregation in protoplanetary discs with the help of multi-frequency spectral index maps' (1904.05251) provide insights into dust properties and their evolution, contributing evidence relevant to the question about radial variations in dust opacity spectral index.
